title: Compare
sides.shots: Shot A vs shot B (difference = B − A)
sides.sets: A: {a} shots vs B: {b} shots (difference = mean B − mean A)
same_setup: Same camera setup: a fair comparison
note.view_mismatch: Different camera angles ({a} vs {b}): they measure different numbers
note.club_mismatch: Different clubs ({a} vs {b}): speed and distance are not comparable
note.mixed_presets: A group mixes shots from different camera setups
note.mixed_views: A group mixes camera angles: its average means little
note.mixed_clubs: A group mixes clubs: its average means little
note.small_sample: One group has fewer than {min} shots: you can see the difference but not whether it is luck
note.other: Something about this comparison needs care
sig.unknown: cannot tell whether it is luck
nothing: No number was measured on both sides
star_note: * means the difference is outside the 95 % margin of error.
how: “Usual variation” uses each shot’s margin of error (or the spread within a group) at {n} % confidence.
note.model_mismatch: The groups were worked out with different versions of the estimation model: a difference may come from the model, not from you
